absentReason: One routine evaluates every Booking and raises warnings with their text, kind and strength, never a block, but only the unpaid prepayment rule exists so far. Later phases add theirs: base units outside the RVG group's range (19), a child as the payer on the Booking and insurer-will-pay with no insurer Contract (21), a prepaid procedure with no price on the anaesthetist's own Contract (27) and a paying patient with a balance (40).
